newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN STOCKS DIVE ON PROFIT-TAKING BEFORE CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN STOCKS DIVE ON PROFIT-TAKING BEFORE CLOSE.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dived before the close on Friday on pre-weekend profit-taking, which wiped out most of the index's earlier gains, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-index rose 6.55 points, or 0.33 percent, to 2,019.76, off from early highs at 2,035.71. Losers led gainers 119 to 59 after two hours of trading at 11.30 a.m. (0630 GMT).
Pakistan telecom rose 0.45 to 43.80 and ICI Pakistan 1.00 to 30.55.
